verdict.rationale: Bento's API documentation confirms creating/updating contacts (subscribers) with custom fields at scale (1-1000 per batch, bulk create/update), plus a data-deletion/anonymization endpoint for suppression, and custom fields as first-class data attributes. missing for 10: no explicit rate-limit or throughput benchmarks for 'production scale', no independent/hands-on developer corroboration of large-scale API usage beyond vendor docs.
